name: Trail 1 (Kalinjer)
description: A scenic route through dense forest and rocky paths, ending near Pir Sohawa Road. Popular with nature lovers for its steady, moderate climb.

name: Trail 2
description: Starts near Islamabad Zoo and leads up to Daman-e-Koh viewpoint, a relatively gentle 1 to 1.5 hour hike with strong city views.

name: Trail 3 (near Monal)
description: The oldest and most famous trail in Margalla Hills, starting at sector F-6. Steep in sections, well-marked, and ends near where Monal Restaurant used to sit on Pir Sohawa Road.

name: Trail 4
description: A steep connecting trail between Trail 3 and Trail 5, also linked to Trail 6. Strenuous despite its short length.

name: Trail 5 (Pir Sohawa)
description: Easy for the first 2-3 km, then a steep final stretch to the top of Pir Sohawa Road. Criss-crossed by streams and springs with strong views from the summit.

name: Trail 6
description: Entrance tucked behind Faisal Mosque, making it less crowded. Has a separate track for mountain biking and cycling, and is popular for bird watching.
